title: PostgreSQL backup guide
text: Use pg_dump for nightly database backups. Restore archives with pg_restore and verify the row counts after recovery.
query: recover the database from last night backup

title: Docker service failure
text: The payments container cannot reach PostgreSQL on port 5432. Inspect the compose network and DATABASE_URL connection string.

title: Python memory investigation
text: tracemalloc snapshots compare allocations between requests. A growing list of cached response bodies caused the memory leak.

title: React accessibility checklist
text: Use keyboard focus indicators and accessible button names. Dialogs must trap focus and return it when dismissed.

title: Optical signal monitoring
text: Laser current and optical power identify soft failures. OSNR and bit error rate describe the quality of an optical lightpath.

title: Worker retry design
text: A transactional outbox commits an approved job with its audit log. Workers use leases, exponential backoff and a dead letter queue.
query: approved job retries after abandoned worker

title: Satellite propagation notes
text: Two line element records describe satellites. SGP4 computes a current position from the orbital elements and timestamp.
query: calculate satellite position from orbital records

title: Network DNS snapshot
text: DNS lookups time out while TCP handshakes succeed. A bounded network snapshot records symptoms without assigning blame to the ISP.

title: Inventory reconciliation
text: Compare physical inventory with SAP book stock. Investigate negative variances using goods issue records and production consumption.

title: Paint oven troubleshooting
text: Underbake occurs when metal temperature stays below the required cure window. Record the oven temperature profile before changing line speed.

title: Travel planning Kyoto
text: Take the train to Kyoto station and visit the bamboo grove early. Reserve museum tickets and leave time for a rainy afternoon.

title: Recipe for lentil soup
text: Simmer red lentils with carrots, cumin and vegetable stock. Add lemon juice after cooking for a bright finish.

title: Guitar practice log
text: Practice alternate picking slowly with a metronome. Increase tempo only after every note sounds clean.

title: Budget spreadsheet review
text: Track monthly rent, groceries and electricity bills. Move the remaining income into an emergency savings fund.

title: Chess endgame study
text: Opposition matters in king and pawn endings. Keep the rook behind a passed pawn and activate the king.

title: Photograph exposure guide
text: A fast shutter freezes moving subjects. Aperture controls depth of field, while high ISO adds noise in low light.
query: camera low light shutter aperture settings

title: Linux disk investigation
text: The filesystem is full because journal logs accumulated. Inspect disk usage with du and rotate logs before deleting unrelated files.
query: linux full disk journal log rotation

title: TLS certificate renewal
text: The HTTPS certificate expires on Friday. Renew it and verify the chain, hostname and expiry from the client.

title: Git conflict resolution
text: A merge conflict changed the same function on two branches. Compare both versions, keep intended behavior and run the tests.

title: Search ranking evaluation
text: Recall at five counts targets among the first five results. Mean reciprocal rank rewards earlier correct matches.
query: measure retrieval target ranking recall mrr

title: SQLite concurrency note
text: Write ahead logging allows readers during a write transaction. Configure a busy timeout and close connections promptly.
query: sqlite wal concurrent readers database timeout

title: Privacy capture checklist
text: Pause screenshot recording before opening passwords. Exclude credential manager applications and keep history on local encrypted storage.

title: Cache expiry incident
text: A stale weather response stayed in the in-memory cache. Shorten the time to live and refresh entries after expiry.

title: Test flakiness analysis
text: Mocked HTTP requests can finish within one clock tick. Inject a deterministic clock instead of asserting elapsed wall time is positive.
query: mock http flaky timing test deterministic clock
